Container.Name: Slip
Container.Overview: Slip is a lightning-fast, self-hosted visual bookmark archive and reading space. Inspired by mymind. Built with modern Node.js/TypeScript, React, and SQLite (WAL mode + FTS5 full-text indexing), it features a clean visual stream grid, distraction-free reader mode, robust tag search, and optional Bring Your Own AI (BYO-AI) integrations.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: slip bookmark archive read later mymind visual organizer

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port used by the Slip web interface.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Persistent directory for storing Slip's SQLite database (bookmarks.db) and thumbnail cache.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container (default 99 for Unraid nobody user).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container (default 100 for Unraid users group).

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true if hosting behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.
